summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a $350 million underwritten public offering of common stock (Nasdaq: AMLX), with Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley, Guggenheim Securities, and LifeSci Capital as underwriters. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3), not a special situation. The closing price on August 18, 2026 was $35.11 per share; per-share terms and greenshoe option were not finalized. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary follow-on offering with no strategic or structural event—no board recommendation, premium, or risk-arb angle. What to watch: offer pricing, upsizing, and use of proceeds.
